name: EVE Vanguard
detailed_description:
‎


Roadmap

Early Access in Summer 2026


About the Game

EVE Vanguard is an upcoming sandbox MMOFPS for PC, set within the vast star cluster of New Eden, 21,000 years in the far future. Directly impacting the biggest war in gaming, Vanguard descend onto the surface of hostile worlds to fight for profit, power and infamy. As an immortal warclone – a technologically enhanced mercenary – you’ll harness adaptive weaponry to counter emergent threats and upgrade your lethal capabilities.

IMPACT A LIVING WARZONE

Shape the future of a persistent, player-driven universe with no resets. New Eden is defined by players, with evolving politics, economies, territorial control, and an open contract system. Every commission, contract, kill, and extraction leaves its mark—on your warclone, your faction, and the ongoing conflict across the star cluster.

BECOME A LETHAL WARCLONE

The Vanguard usher in a new era of war. They are agents of chaos - set loose upon the stars. As a Vanguard you are a mercenary with the power to shape your own destiny. Deploy from Warbarges to the surface of planets, scavenge resources, and acquire your next target.

DEPLOY PLANET-SIDE

Explore the star cluster of New Eden from a human-scale perspective. Traverse distinct, hostile landscapes—from tropical jungles to toxic hellscapes—each offering unique threats and opportunities.

FORGE YOUR OWN PATH

Play your way with the goals you set. Choose how you fight and what you fight for. Scavenge, mine, hunt, craft, trade, survive—and define your own victories. The battlefield is yours to dominate.

ADAPT TO ASCEND

Personalize your capabilities with adaptive weaponry to meet any threat. Modify and calibrate your weapons and suits using modules that change functionality and effectiveness for each emerging situation. Customize your weapon and suit and evolve your warclone to match your playstyle.

ONE UNIVERSE, ONE WAR

EVE Vanguard is directly interconnected to sci-fi MMO EVE Online, which features over 20 years of record-breaking, player-driven battles. Shared goals, efforts, and consequences echo across both games. Capsuleer or Vanguard, this is one universe, one war, one community.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (21H2/19044) / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (Latest) / Windows 11 64-bit (Latest)
  • Processor: Intel i5-11600K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3080 / AMD Radeon RX 6900 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
